LESSON: POSITION AND SIZE OF COUNTRIES IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Afr
Topic 1.1: Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you determine the position of countries in Eastern Africa?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the countries of Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the position and size of countries in Eastern Africa
3. use latitudes and longitudes to locate places on a map

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

• Today’s maths focus is Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

• Start with objects you can touch or draw — stones, sticks, bottle tops, or drawings in your book.

• Say the steps aloud as you work so you do not skip a stage.

• Check your answer with a second method or by estimating.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market, count 10 mangoes and put them in 2 groups of 5.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row and write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and receive 5 more, you have 12 shillings.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Solve three short problems about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa using drawings.
2. Explain one solution to a partner in your own words.
3. Make up one new word problem set in your county or school.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five practice questions and solve them in your book.
2. Show your working clearly — not only the final answer.
3. Teach a younger learner one idea from this lesson with bottle tops or drawings.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Locate, in groups, the position of countries in Eastern Africa using an atlas/appropriate media,
2. Draw, colour and display the map of Eastern Africa in class,
3. In pairs, identify latitudes and longitudes of Eastern Africa using appropriate media,
4. Creativity and imagination: Learners undertake tasks that encourage artistic expression of ideas as they play games in groups on position and sizes of countries in Eastern Africa.
5. Communication and collaboration: Learners contribute to group work as they locate in groups the position of countries in Eastern Africa using an atlas/appropriate media. Values:

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Use objects or drawings when a sum feels hard.
2. Check every answer.
3. Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is used in real Kenyan life — market, school, and home.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
